_readme: Paid placements, matching ads/rate-card.md. Empty arrays / null = 'Sponsor slot - available' placeholders. See README.md > Sponsor slots for slot ids, where they render, and the entry format. Every entry renders labeled and every link gets rel="sponsored noopener" automatically. Entries only render between start and end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, evaluated at build time), so rebuild when a placement starts or ends.

_exampleEntry.text: Family-owned movers serving the Metro East. Up to 40 words.
